in_marathi.name: Debashis
in_marathi.long_meaning: Debashis हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Debashis is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'deba' meaning 'god' and 'shis' meaning 'master' or 'learned'. This name is given to a child who is believed to possess the qualities of a wise and intelligent god.
